trainingEnvironment: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
hypothesis: The rejected Pro candidate has large cash/draw-heavy and strong-three-card losses. A fresh-seed phase diagnostic suggests that keeping the published Standard DRAW policy while improving BET may remove part of those losses; the 2M one-hand opening audit does not establish continuous-session strength.
intervention: Keep the published Standard ONNX policy frozen for all DRAW decisions, including bootstrap and RL. Train and imitate BET decisions only. Keep a fixed hero seat and one opponent profile within each up-to-20-hand controller session, resetting after table finish or hero elimination. Bootstrap 1000 real-controller hands and perform 4000 RL hands across 10 seat/mode groups. Preserve BET fold and raise anchors, reduce ongoing reference imitation to one step per 10 RL hands. Stop at 5000 hands.
diagnosticRule: At the exact 5000-hand stop, inspect legal-action/chip conservation, BET/DRAW route counts, BET opening classes and per-profile exposure. Export privately and compare on new independent continuous 20-hand controller sessions by seat/mode/profile, with session-level uncertainty. Do not infer product strength from the 2M one-hand audit or this training checkpoint.
promotionRule: No public model or registry change without a separate preregistered product evaluation and browser actual-use, legal-action/amount, deadline/fallback, chip and trace gates. Ambiguous or losing cells are not promoted.
safety: 5k is a diagnosis stop gate only. S01 v2 remains stopped; other nine Standard games remain gated until all D03 tiers finish.
